inlines.v: PER'FORATE, verb transitive [Latin perforo; per and foro; Eng. to bore.] 1. To bore through. 2. To pierce with a pointed instrument; to make a hole or holes through any thing by boring or driving; as, to perforate the bottom of a vessel.
